title: Run Gemini or Claude Inside Zoho Flow Instantly #Shorts
description:
Learn how to connect new AI models like Claude or Gemini to Zoho Flow using custom API steps without writing any Deluge code.

1. Create a Zoho Flow triggered by an inbound CRM lead or Support ticket.
2. Add the 'AI' or 'Custom API' step inside the flow and paste the new LLM API endpoint.
3. Map the AI response (like lead sentiment or classification) directly to Zoho fields.

API / tool used:
- name: Anthropic Messages API / Gemini API
- endpoint: POST https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages
- scope: External API
- docs: Anthropic API Documentation

AI + Zoho automations every day - follow @GSXAutomation
